title: Aloe Vera: Nature's Soothing Gel
summary: Why aloe calms an irritated scalp, and how to use fresh gel from the leaf.
body:
Aloe vera is known for its soothing, moisturizing properties, and is a gentle friend to an irritated scalp.

## Fresh aloe gel

Scoop the gel from a fresh leaf and blend it smooth. Apply directly to your scalp for quick relief from itching.
